integrity: Proof-based general family theorem; reproducible exact finite census. Bibliographic novelty remains subject to independent review.
scientific_limitations: Exact permanent-removal binary mutualistic model. Product-incidence networks and small simple pair-incidence graph census; no adaptive ecological rewiring, heterogeneous weights or stochastic demographic cascades. General arbitrary-network ranking is not solved.
title: Simultaneous extinction-curve optimality by capped balancing in mutualistic networks
